name: N the Zone Ink
old_description: Central Oregon's Largest Custom Apparel Shop for Screen Printing, Embroidery & Promo Products - Based in Bend, Oregon.
about:
N the Zone Ink operates from Bend, Oregon, serving Central Oregon as a custom apparel and promotional products company. The business focuses on screen printing, embroidery, and heat pressing for branded merchandise.

The shop provides a range of decoration services including screen printing, embroidery, heat press, sewing, and finishing, along with promotional products, stickers, banners, and online store management. A showroom at 62958 Layton Avenue Suite 4 stocks hundreds of garments, headwear, and promotional items from suppliers such as SanMar, Lane Seven, and Richardson, allowing customers to evaluate materials and decoration quality in person. The company does not accept customer-supplied garments, sourcing all items itself to maintain quality control.

Clients include businesses needing company uniforms, sports teams requiring jerseys and warm-up gear, retail brands, and event organizers. The company also serves small businesses and individuals seeking custom merchandise for promotional or personal use. Testimonials highlight work with local businesses in Bend and surrounding areas.

N the Zone Ink emphasizes its in-house design team, which assists with everything from simple adjustments to full custom designs. The company cites its commitment to integrity, uncompromising quality, expert craftsmanship, and customer-centric service as key differentiators, aiming to deliver durable, impressive decorated apparel through a transparent process.
